about.name: Dr. Meher Kapadia
about.title: Founder & Lead Prosthodontist
about.bio: Dr. Meher started Smile Craft after a decade of hospital practice in South Mumbai, where she saw too many people put off dental care because it felt rushed and scary. Here, every visit begins with a ten-minute conversation, a clear written estimate in rupees, and a promise of no surprise add-ons. The clinic keeps a strict single-use instrument policy and runs on appointment slots, so you are out in time for your 6:12 from CSMT.

faqs.q: Is a root canal really painless?
faqs.a: Yes. We use a topical gel, then a slow computer-assisted local anaesthetic, so most patients feel only pressure. Mild soreness for a day is normal and is managed with a standard painkiller.

faqs.q: How much will my treatment cost?
faqs.a: You get a written estimate in rupees before any work starts. Prices on this page are starting prices; the final amount depends on your case, and we never add procedures without asking.

faqs.q: Do you accept dental insurance or cashless claims?
faqs.a: We provide detailed invoices and treatment reports for reimbursement claims. Cashless tie-ups vary by insurer, so please message us on WhatsApp before your visit.

faqs.q: How long does a clear-aligner treatment take?
faqs.a: Mild crowding usually takes 6 to 9 months, moderate cases 12 to 18 months. You visit every 6 to 8 weeks, which is easy to fit around a Fort office schedule.
Yes. We keep a few same-day slots every working day for toothache, broken teeth and lost fillings. Call us before 4 PM on weekdays and we will fit you in.

faqs.q: What are your timings and how do I reach the clinic?
faqs.a: We are open Monday to Friday 10 AM to 7 PM and Saturday 10 AM to 4 PM. The clinic is a 5-minute walk from CSMT station and Flora Fountain, with paid parking at the Hutatma Chowk lot.
